verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Pigment ships its own agents (Modeler and Analyst), but the evidence only documents Pigment acting as an MCP server for Claude, Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT. That is the server role and does not count for this client-side story. 'Agent Connectors' to Notion, Google Drive and Slack are first-party connectors, with no evidence that users can register arbitrary MCP servers for Pigment's agents to call.
